lines.text: Xerxes reigned over 127 provinces from India to Cush and sat on his royal throne in the citadel of Susa.
In the third year of his reign, Xerxes held a feast for his officials and displayed his kingdom's riches for 180 days.
At the end of this time, the king held a seven-day feast in the garden court for everyone in the citadel of Babylon.
On the seventh day, the king sent seven eunuchs to bring Queen Vashti, but she refused to come, and he became furious.
Memucan advised a royal decree, recorded in the laws of Persia and Media, that Vashti never again enter the king's presence.
